# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and memory efficiency**

## Highlights

This unreleased update improves Android rendering, memory use, and WebGPU packaging across supported platforms. It synchronizes Android texture rendering with display refresh, reduces allocations in image and text-shaping paths, packages WebGPU support into the native library, and corrects front-buffered stream retention.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering synchronized** — Coordinates continuous texture rendering with the display refresh cycle while preserving explicit render requests and lifecycle behavior. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Front-buffered streams release retained data** — Corrects stream retention so buffered input can be released when it is no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Image and shaping allocations reduced** — Managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate allocation, while HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding and feature-string decoding reuse storage without changing results. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **WebGPU implementation packaged with the native library** — Includes the WebGPU C++ support in libSkiaSharp.a, keeping consumer WebAssembly application links free of its C++ compiler settings. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
